status: Fixed before extension training and test evaluation; the original GTSRB results were already known
belgium_pretraining_audit_amendment: 2026-10-14, before Belgium feature extraction or training: also exclude training groups whose class/filename prefix is present in official test. This is a conservative identifier audit, not a claim that all collisions are the same physical sign. Test stays unchanged. Macro metrics use only test-supported classes; accuracy retains all 62 prediction alternatives.
backbone_compute: Frozen pretrained backbone, CUDA autocast float16, float16 feature cache, eval mode
image_transform: Provided inclusive ROI, bilinear resize to 224x224, ImageNet normalization, no augmentation; shared across backbones
convnext_representation: TorchVision ImageNet1K V1; global average pooling followed by pretrained layer normalization; new 768-64 ReLU/dropout(0.5), temporary classification layer

head_selection.budget: largest registered budget for each dataset
head_selection.tie_rule: first entry in fixed loop order
head_selection.lock: same selected config across seeds and budgets; separate selection for each dataset/backbone

head_sampling: balanced per-class upper bound; capped at available training examples without replacement; shared nested samples for all heads within a seed
native_convnext_control: Unit-normalized signed 768-dimensional frozen features, multinomial logistic regression with validation-only C selection. Balanced registered budgets at three sampling seeds, and all-training-label probe once per dataset. Not matched to the 64-dimensional representation adaptation label budget.
basis_diagnostic: At sigma=2, fixed seed 20261014 random orthogonal change of basis and coordinate permutation; kernel discrepancies on fixed training pairs only, no classifier tuning or test-based selection
statistical_interpretation: Seed means and sample SD; paired correctness for matched kernels, exact McNemar and Holm adjustment across newly added matched comparisons; image independence caveat remains
claims: No state-of-the-art or wavelet superiority claim without supporting observations; no full fine-tuning or end-to-end few-shot claim
